Crisyrel Awe, following the eight-hour protest of some Persons Deprived of Liberty (PDLs)  over alleged unfair treatment in the facility on Thursday, according to Jail Senior Insp. Concurrently, Aro is the operations chief of BJMP-NIR.| Glazyl Masculino
